Extract data about executed Monolix runs

Source: R/runs_data.R
runs_data.Rd

Reads the run store for Monolix jobs that have been submitted and recorded. Returns a data frame with basic job information or detailed file tracking data.

Usage

runs_data(
  store = default_store(),
  include_files = FALSE,
  ignore_failed_runs = FALSE,
  latest_only = FALSE,
  include_summary = FALSE
)

Arguments

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it.

include_files

Logical scalar. Whether to include details about input and output files in the data. Default is FALSE.

ignore_failed_runs

Logical scalar. Whether to exclude runs where completed_at is missing or the run finished without results (i.e., failed, incomplete or "no_results" runs). Default is FALSE.

latest_only

Logical scalar. Whether to return only the latest run (by submitted_at) for each project file. Default is FALSE.

include_summary

Logical scalar. Whether to include the statistics parsed from the run's results (summary.txt for Monolix, the result tables for PKanalix, the Simulation/ and Endpoints/ files for Simulx). Default is FALSE.

Value

A data frame with run information, newest submission first. Contains columns: run_id (character), job_id, project_name, project_path, data_file, model_file, thread, tool, mode, config, project_file_timestamp, project_file_sha256, cmd, software_version, user, submitted_at, completed_at, state, recorded_late. user is the account that launched the run. software_version is the MonolixSuite version stated in the run's summary.txt (Monolix, PKanalix) when recorded, else the version implied by the command (e.g. "2024R1" for mono24), else NA. state is one of "submit_failed", "unrecorded", "completion_crashed", "recorded", "recorded_late" or "no_results" (recorded, but a Monolix, PKanalix or Simulx run without results). When include_files = TRUE, additionally contains one row per input and output file with io_type, file_name, file_path, file_timestamp and sha256. When include_summary = TRUE, additionally contains the run statistics: for Monolix, those of summary.txt and one n_obs_<type> column per observation type; for PKanalix, tasks (the tasks with results, e.g. "nca,ca,be"), n_individuals, the compartmental analysis criteria ofv (-2LL), aic, bic and ca_cost, and per bioequivalence parameter the columns be_<parameter>_ratio, be_<parameter>_ci_lower, be_<parameter>_ci_upper and be_<parameter>_bioequivalent (logical). A run with more than one formulation gets be_<formulation>_<parameter>_... columns. For Simulx, tasks ("simulation", "simulation,endpoint"). Columns of the other tools are NA. Characters in <type>, <parameter> and <formulation> other than letters, digits and _ are replaced by _, so "obsid 1" gives n_obs_obsid_1. Timestamps are in the session time zone. Returns NULL invisibly, with a message, when there are no runs.
